reviews.comment: Token privacy fully correct (verified clean + hermetic test). Handshake works, but the new POST /hub/reregister endpoint has 2 blockers: (1) DoS — each call leaks a liveness connection (no throttle/in-flight guard; holdLiveness never closes the prior conn; upsert returns existing token so old loop never superseded); (2) CSRF + proxy-bypass — simple-POST CSRF from any page, and the master proxy forwards /p/<id>/hub/reregister to the loopback endpoint so a LAN peer defeats the gate. Fixes localized to reregister/holdLiveness + a proxy /hub/ guard.

fix.comment: Fixed blockers 1-2. B1 (DoS/leak): reregister single-flight+throttled; holdLiveness epoch-supersedes + destroys prior conn (one liveness connection). B2 (CSRF+proxy-bypass): /hub/reregister rejects Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site; master proxy 404s /p/<id>/hub/*. Verified live + 340 tests.

reviews.comment: Round 2 APPROVED. All 3 Round-1 blockers fixed + re-verified live (leak: 3->1 conn via epoch teardown+single-flight; CSRF: Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site->403; proxy /hub/* ->404) + hermetic test. Token privacy intact. 340 tests. One non-blocking edge: reregister 5s-cooldown can briefly strand offline after a rapid double master-restart; self-heals on next reregister trigger. Suggested follow-up hardening noted.
